title: Complete specification stops without invented issues
expected_summary: Must not invent an interactive load-bearing issue. It can state that no load-bearing uncertainty remains and avoid unnecessary redesign.

turns.user: Review the specification with the spec-grilling skill.
assertions: Does not invent an interactive issue or redesign a settled specification.

Writes and links .spec-grill/spec/decision-graph.ai.md with interactive complete metadata, recording relevant settled load-bearing decisions and evidence without reopening them. If no load-bearing decisions exist, records an explicit empty graph.
